findings.finding: (blocking) The issue's own spec is empty and the parent spec has no Acceptance section, so every acceptance sentence is the planner's derivation; the 1070 plan's quoted acceptance line does not exist in this tree's design document.
findings.answer: The plan names dispatch://LEGSMOKE-1163/artifact/spec v1 as the only design document, quotes its Summary and Scope verbatim, states the child's spec.md is empty, labels C1–C3 as the planner's derivation, never quotes the 1070 acceptance sentence as spec, and names the empty-spec fact for the architect in the completion summary.

findings.finding: (blocking) 'a single line that names this issue' has two readings with the design in a parent spec: LEGSMOKE-1163 (the document's issue) or LEGSMOKE-1166 (the issue worked); the first sends three siblings to one path.
findings.answer: D1 pins path smoke/LEGSMOKE-1166.md and L1 `LEGSMOKE-1166: <title>` by the per-key convention (138 smoke files) and the sibling collision the other reading causes; check = head -1 string-equal to L1 and grep -c '^LEGSMOKE-1166: ' = 1; flagged to the architect as overturnable.

findings.finding: (blocking) No pre-Legion commit sits on this branch (B == F == 6d843f28), so the 1070 plan's two-base apparatus (fixturePaths, landingDiff, Departure 1, never-rewrite-B) describes a state this branch does not have.
findings.answer: One base, 6d843f28, in the constants; D3 states the …-LEGSMOKE-1056.md rule does not apply and why; expectedMergeFiles = the marker plus any retro note; specDepartures carries only the conditional retro note.

findings.finding: (blocking) 'adds exactly one file / Nothing else changes' names no head and no base, and is literally false while .legion/ handoffs sit on the branch and retro may add a note.
findings.answer: C1 gives an artefact per head: legionDiff from 6d843f28 with .legion/ excluded ([] at planHead; the one path +1/-0 at firstCodeHead and the handoff heads; +2/-0 from appendHead; plus retro notes at retroHead with `jj file list -r <retroHead> 'root:.legion/LEGSMOKE-1166'` empty); mergeFiles = expectedMergeFiles at mergeSha; PR count 0 before / 1 after the first code push.

findings.finding: (blocking) The second line has no observable trigger, text, cap or author; the repository holds Stage 3 files with three appended rounds.
findings.answer: D2: trigger = a CHANGES_REQUESTED review carrying `append one more line` with one inline comment (secondLineDiscriminator ≥ 1), existing in this proof only on the driver's targeted message; text = the ask's literal line else L2 with the 124-byte constants; cap = one line for the whole issue (no LEGSMOKE-*.md carries a round 2 or 3 line; the S*.md three-round files are the Stage 3 design); author = the implementer alone as an untrailered code push; a late ask returns only through request_backward_move. The cap is flagged to the architect as a product reading.

findings.finding: (blocking) 'a single line' is undefined in bytes, and every byte constant differs from the 1070 run (85/124 here against 126/165).
findings.answer: C2 is the conjunction wc -l=1, wc -c=85, last byte 0a, first bytes 4c 45 47, zero 0d, sha256 038493ed…, blob 9373cdef…, head -1 = L1, grep -c = 1, with the altered/CRLF/no-final-LF digests as mismatch controls; the two-line values are pinned; the recorded byte string is the authority after planning, so a title edit is not a stop.

findings.finding: (should-answer) The production check's predicate is undefined for a repository whose production is main itself, and the 1070 plan's 'pending never' invites a false pass.
findings.answer: D7: the access path is the repository read; compare/<mergeSha>...main identical or ahead means production carries the merge, then the contents reads at mergeSha and main, mergeFiles = expectedMergeFiles, commits-by-path = [mergeSha], the base 404 control and checkRuns at retroHead decide pass; main not carrying mergeSha is an honest pending (nothing wakes the next look before the bound); any difference is fail with a new Dispatch issue, never a child.
